items.title_zh: GitHub：api-evangelist/brainco——BrainCo 公共 API 第三方档案
items.title_en: GitHub: api-evangelist/brainco — Third-Party Profile of BrainCo’s Public API Surface
bullets_zh: API Evangelist 于 2026-09-23 发布 BrainCo 公共 API 的第三方 GitHub 档案。
该档案称 BrainCo 源自哈佛创新实验室，开发非侵入式 BCI 硬件与开发者 SDK。
它有助于开发者跟踪消费级或科研 EEG 头环 API 与集成接口。
bullets_en: API Evangelist published a third-party GitHub profile of BrainCo’s public API surface on 2026-09-23.
The profile describes BrainCo as a Harvard-innovation-lab-founded company building non-invasive BCI hardware and developer SDKs.
It is useful for developers tracking consumer or research EEG headset APIs and integration surfaces.
items.brief: GitHub 上的 BrainCo 公共 API 第三方档案，便于跟踪非侵入式 BCI 开发者接口。
items.brief_en: A third-party GitHub profile of BrainCo’s public API for tracking non-invasive BCI developer interfaces.
items.raw_excerpt: BrainCo — independent third-party profile of a public API surface, by API Evangelist. BrainCo is a Harvard-innovation-lab-founded neurotechnology company building non-invasive brain-computer interface (BCI) hardware and the developer SDKs that surround it. Its consumer and research line centers on wearable EEG headbands - Focus, Focus1 and FocusCal

items.title_en: IronBCI: Wearable BLE Brain-Computer Interface SDK
bullets_zh: IronBCI是一个采用蓝牙连接的可穿戴脑机接口开源项目。
它结合ADS1299模拟前端与STM32微控制器硬件，并提供移动应用SDK。
该仓库支持在自定义可穿戴设备上构建非侵入式BCI应用。
bullets_en: IronBCI is an open-source wearable brain-computer-interface project using BLE connectivity.
It combines ADS1299 analog front-end and STM32 microcontroller hardware with a mobile-app SDK.
The repository supports building non-invasive BCI applications on custom wearable devices.
items.brief: 基于ADS1299与STM32的可穿戴BLE BCI硬件及移动SDK。
items.brief_en: Wearable BLE BCI hardware using ADS1299 and STM32 with a mobile application SDK.
items.raw_excerpt: Wearable (BLE) Brain-Computer Interface, ADS1299 and STM32 with SDK for mobile application

items.title_zh: ADS1299 核心 SDK：开放 EEG/BCI 生态
items.title_en: ADS1299 Core SDK for Open EEG/BCI Ecosystem
bullets_zh: 面向 ADS1299 的开源 SDK 与参考生态，覆盖 8–64 通道 EEG/BCI 硬件。
涵盖 MCU/SoC/DSP/FPGA 目标、Verilog RTL、PC/移动/Linux 集成及 Python/MATLAB/R 分析流程。
面向非侵入式 EEG 研究与消费级 BCI 开发，提供验证与教育资源。
bullets_en: Open-source SDK and reference ecosystem for ADS1299-based EEG/BCI hardware from 8 to 64 channels.
Covers MCU/SoC/DSP/FPGA targets, Verilog RTL, PC/mobile/Linux integration, and Python/MATLAB/R analysis workflows.
Targets non-invasive EEG research and consumer BCI development with validation and education resources.
items.brief: 面向ADS1299的开放EEG/BCI SDK生态，支持非侵入式硬件与分析。
items.brief_en: Open ADS1299 EEG/BCI SDK ecosystem for non-invasive hardware, analysis, and research workflows.
items.raw_excerpt: Building the world’s largest and most comprehensive open ADS1299 EEG/BCI ecosystem — 8–64CH hardware, 200 MCU/SoC/DSP & FPGA target/reference packages, Verilog RTL, PC/mobile/Linux integration, Python/MATLAB/R EEG analysis, BCI workflows, validation, education and research.

items.title_zh: 用于辅助BCI的多模态EEG/面部情绪分析器
items.title_en: Multimodal EEG/Facial Emotion Analyzer for Assistive BCI
bullets_zh: 将 MobileNetV2 面部情绪分类器与基于 EEGNet 的实时/回放 EEG 分类器通过 LSL 结合。
支持真实头带或录制数据、个性化校准以及用于情感上下文的多模态融合。
设计为使用非侵入式 EEG 而非植入物的辅助 BCI 层。
bullets_en: Combines a MobileNetV2 facial emotion classifier with an EEGNet-based live/replay EEG classifier over LSL.
Supports real headsets or recorded data, personalized calibration, and multimodal fusion for affective context.
Designed as an assistive BCI layer using non-invasive EEG rather than implants.
items.brief: 多模态面部与EEG情绪识别工具，服务非侵入式辅助BCI。
items.brief_en: Multimodal facial+EEG emotion recognition toolkit for non-invasive assistive BCI contexts.
items.raw_excerpt: Multimodal affect recognition suite pairing a facial emotion classifier (MobileNetV2) with a live EEG classifier (EEGNet, DREAMER-trained) over LSL — real headset or replay, personalized calibration, and fusion. Built as an affective context layer for assistive BCI systems.

It helps developers acquire, stream, and process consumer EEG data.
